indicator_name: National Bank net operations on the FX market (interventions) and FX sales mirroring gold purchases, monthly
description: Операции Национального Банка на валютном рынке (интервенции), нетто, и продажи валюты в рамках зеркалирования покупок золота, помесячно
methodology: NET: «Объем операций НБРК на валютном рынке», mln USD, + net purchase / − net sale, 1996-01 onward (2014-10 −6 002.1, 2020-03 −1 487.6, 2022-03 −990.5, 2025-07 −125.6). July-November 2024 include the operations to buy Kazatomprom shares for the National Fund (footnote «*»; November 2024 −1 181 of which 133.8). MIRRORING_USD / MIRRORING_KZT: FX sales «для целей монетарной нейтральности» mirroring the NBK's priority purchases of refined gold, from 2025-01 (the KZT amount is set per quarter). Sales of the National Fund's FX for budget transfers are NATIONAL_FUND_DOMESTIC_OPERATIONS (form 470), not here. Dated by the month of the operations; published about the 10th of the month after next.
